topic: Which cloud and local coding models are worth offering in Moonzila as of 2026-10-05: current API model ids with context and output limits, tool-calling reliability, how vendors use and retain API inputs, and for small local models their licences, Ollama availability and sizes, runtime version and CPU requirements
notes: Run 2 of 2, the local side: 14 owner pages named directly plus 1 search keeping 1 page = 15 pages (maxScrapes 15), about 17 credits. Run it after research/plan.json; pages already captured are cache hits and cost nothing. No plan-level prefer (review round 1, fix 3). Where each URL comes from (grep of every raw capture under docs/, 2026-10-05; full table in research/DISCOVERY.md under Collection plan): linked from an existing capture - the four Ollama library pages, the Ollama releases page, the Gemma 4 model card; linked from no capture, pattern-derived, may 404 - the Qwen3-0.6B and three Qwen3.5 LICENSE files, the granite-4.0-1b card, the Phi-4-mini-instruct LICENSE, and both CMakeLists.txt files at v0.34.4 (the tag's raw path is proven by three v0.34.4 captures in docs/handoff/work/research; main's capture shows a commit moving GGML to llama-server, so the ggml path may differ at the tag). Licences are read on each publisher's own host: Ollama redistributes the weights and shows only the default tag's layers, so its licence layer is context. A licence URL that 404s is replaced by the publisher repository link a run-2 capture gives (the Ollama library pages are in this run), copied, as a conditional page - not by a guessed second spelling (review round 2, fix 5; research/DISCOVERY.md, Capture risks). Not collected again, by decision: the qwen3:0.6b tag size and the Ollama Windows requirements (docs/handoff/work/research E-17, E-11). Budget: about 35 credits for runs 1 and 2 together; the conditional pages and the order in which they give way at the 45-credit cap are in research/DISCOVERY.md under Capture risks.
